description: This Kotlin file defines a sealed interface 'OnboardingUiState' and its various implementations to represent the onboarding state in the 'for you' screen of the application. It includes states for loading, failure, non-appearance, and a shown state containing a list of topics.

classes.name: Loading
classes.description: Represents the loading state of onboarding.

classes.name: LoadFailed
classes.description: Represents the failure to load onboarding.

classes.name: Shown
classes.description: Represents the state when onboarding topics are shown, containing a list of topics and a computed property to determine dismissability.

methods.name: isDismissable
methods.description: A computed property in the 'Shown' class indicating if the onboarding can be dismissed based on whether any topics are followed.
